Inspect a portable fixed calibration

Source: R/core-fixed-calibration.R
mfrm_calibration_methods.Rd

print() gives a compact lifecycle and scope overview. summary() returns the same identifiers together with coordinate and anchor counts and the structured validation refusals, if any. Both methods inspect the stored artifact and do not refit a model or consult training responses.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_calibration'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_calibration'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.mfrm_calibration'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object, x

An mfrm_calibration returned by the portable calibration workflow.

...

Reserved for generic compatibility.

Value

summary() returns a summary.mfrm_calibration. print() returns its input invisibly.

Details

A calibration artifact intentionally has no plot() method. Its coordinate table mixes facet, step, and interaction parameter roles, and the artifact does not contain calibration-parameter uncertainty. Plot returned score batches with mfrm_calibration_score_methods instead; inspect calibration$parameters$coordinates when auditing stored point coordinates.

See also

mfrm_calibration_workflow, mfrm_calibration_score_methods
